meta.walk: the model walk (TABLE[2*b2+b1], conv 0 except canonical c1a), predicates from pcr_lib.b1_of / b2_of / tr_bal4.bal_b1
meta.reads: pcr_lib INC accounting in both models; the oracle bit is free, a trim pays the cell it gives up plus the head re-read
meta.b0: no memory: a repeated quadruple is a closed period, so the walk repeats for ever and dies at cap = 40 n^2 + 100
meta.bC: one bit "has this quadruple occurred before"; on a repeat trim one cell off the window and continue (trim=1: left, trim=2: sensitivity)
meta.verified: cyc_verify.py: 99/99 INC cells exact vs gw_cells at n=512, 114/114 (delta,end) vs tr_lib; cyc_period.py 800/800 periods
meta.hashmod: tr_lib rows hashmod through hk_engine (epoch machine, not the four-move walk); the numbers here are the four-move walk with hashmod action CUTL/RMINUS, the pcr_lib R_HASHMOD rule
